name: aws-order-handler
description: Sample Node.js TypeScript AWS Lambda project

scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../lambda.zip .
scripts.start: npm run build && node -e "const { handler } = require('./dist/handler.js'); const event = require('./events/checkout.json'); handler(event).then((result) => console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)));"
scripts.test: npm run clean:test && npm run build:test && node --test dist-test/test/**/*.test.js
